description: A short Hustlin link for one channel. Clicks are counted per channel, and the landing URL carries the visitor's tracking code (hlc) so a signup reported with report_conversion or the conversion snippet credits this channel. Approver or higher.

channel.description: Where the link will be posted, used as utm_source: x, linkedin, reddit, producthunt, newsletter, instagram_bio, a podcast name.

content.description: utm_content, to tell two links on the same channel apart (post vs bio).

destination.description: Where the link sends people. Default: the product's funnel destination.

stable.description: Reuse the product's existing link for this channel instead of minting a new one, for bios and profiles where the URL must not change. Default false.

name: track_link
title: Mint a tracked link
